source.author: verg
source.text: Quid soceros legere et gremiis abducere pactas, pacem orare manu, praefigere puppibus arma?
source.text_original: Quid soceros legere et gremiis abducere pactas, / pacem orare manu, praefigere puppibus arma?
source.text_english: Why choose fathers-in-law, and carry off pledged brides from their laps, beg for peace with one hand, and fasten weapons to your ships?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: hic matrum gremiis abducere pactas, negotiatoribus et auidissimis mortalium Syris nobilium puellarum nuptias uendere, non pupillorum, non uiduarum, non uirginum Christi inopiae parcere manusque magis rogantium spectare quam uultus.
reuse.text_original: hic matrum gremiis abducere pactas, negotiatoribus et auidissimis mortalium Syris nobilium puellarum nuptias uendere, non pupillorum, non uiduarum, non uirginum Christi inopiae parcere manusque magis rogantium spectare quam uultus.
reuse.text_english: here they lead away girls promised in marriage from their mothers’ laps, and sell the marriages of noble girls to traffickers and to the most greedy of mortals, Syrians; they do not spare the poverty of orphans, widows, or virgins of Christ, and they look more to the hands of those begging than to their faces.
